thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High token-meter delta detected for customer VoltX Labs (tenant_id=vx-981). Errors and 5xxs increased on dedicated-pool-vx-3. Auto-paged oncall. Incident ID INC-4321. https://internal.redwood/incs/INC-4321

sre_alex: ack. I'm taking lead. starting with metrics and request logs for vx-981. tagging @billing_sam @eng_runtime_li

oncall_maya: oncall here, I'll grab the proxy + runtime traces now. can someone confirm the exact time window?

eng_runtime_li: looking. initial spike 2025-11-18T09:02:xxZ - 09:22:xxZ per trace. I can already see a pattern of duplicated request ids from the edge proxy (retries) that correlate with token increments. grabbing logs...

eng_runtime_li: ```
[09:03:12] req_id=abc123 repeat=1 tokens=312 path=/v1/generate
[09:03:12] req_id=abc123 repeat=2 tokens=312 path=/v1/generate
[09:03:13] req_id=def456 repeat=1 tokens=1 path=/v1/embeddings
[09:03:13] req_id=def456 repeat=2 tokens=1 path=/v1/embeddings
```

billing_sam: billing here. pulling meter. please give me exact start/end (UTC) and I'll run the aggregate.

acct_mgr_ravi: reminder: VoltX is an enterprise VPC customer on committed dedicated capacity. They expect isolation and bill protections. I'm looping in their ops contact @customer_ops_jt. please keep them posted.

customer_ops_jt: thanks Ravi. We're seeing a crazy usage spike in our monitoring and multiple invoices alerted. Could you pause meter ingestion for our tenant until you confirm?

support_julie: suggested mitigation: route vx-981 to an isolated fallback pool (isolate to dedicated-isolated-vx) and pause ingestion pipeline for that tenant. Command to route: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route -d '{"tenant":"vx-981","target":"dedicated-isolated-vx"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```
Can ops or runtime do the route and confirm?

eng_runtime_li: applied the route at 09:10:41Z. logs show new target: dedicated-isolated-vx. sample: `route: vx-981 -> dedicated-isolated-vx (applied by eng_runtime_li)`

billing_sam: ran meter aggregate. window 09:00:00Z - 09:30:00Z. Query: `SELECT sum(tokens) as total_tokens FROM usage WHERE tenant='vx-981' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-11-18T09:00:00Z' AND '2025-11-18T09:30:00Z';`
Result: total_tokens = 2,341,218 (expected normal ~1,020,000 for that window). Delta ~= +1,321,218 tokens. Looks like duplicate counting from retries inflated the meter.

security_anna: any indication of replay attack or malicious activity? so far pattern looks like internal proxy retries triggering duplicate accounting, not external attacker. still monitoring.

oncall_maya: mitigation status: routing moved, ingestion pipeline paused for vx-981 at 09:12:05Z (ingest paused job id=ING-7789). error rate trending down. SLO latency returning toward baseline. recommend hold billing while we validate token accounting.

billing_sam: paused ingestion and placed invoice hold. Opening billing investigation ticket BILL-1054 to reconcile meter and prepare credits/refund if confirmed. Will attach raw usage rows and the duplicate req_id list.

acct_mgr_ravi: I'll notify VoltX procurement and legal that we're holding billing and investigating. Ravi -> JT: we'll propose provisional credit while we reconcile.

customer_ops_jt: appreciated. can you share the timeline and whether the route will remain until full RCA? we don't want to flip back and re-trigger anything.

eng_runtime_li: route will remain in isolated pool until RCA is complete. preliminary root-cause hypothesis: edge proxy mis-sent retried requests without idempotency header, runtime accepted them as fresh and meter pipeline counted duplicates. Need follow-up: ensure idempotency header enforced and meter dedupe at ingestion. Creating RCA ticket ENG-3402.

support_julie: adding a customer-facing blurb for VoltX: "We're investigating a metering anomaly; usage is being held and billing paused. We'll provide an update within 24 hours." sending via CSM channel. :white_check_mark:

oncall_maya: handing off to next oncall (shift change). summary for next: isolated routing applied, ingestion paused, billing hold in place, BILL-1054 open, ENG-3402 RCA created, security monitoring active. If anything re-escalates ping @sre_alex.

billing_sam: will produce a reconciliation report and proposed credit by EOD. provisional credit range ~1.3M tokens ~ $1,100 (estimate, needs pricing map). Ticket BILL-1054 updated.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-4321 status -> mitigated (severity lowered). Notes: tenant isolated and ingestion paused; billing hold in effect; follow-ups created: ENG-3402, BILL-1054. :white_check_mark:

customer_ops_jt: thanks all. please confirm once BILL-1054 has the exact credit number and when the incident is closed from the customer's side.

sre_alex: thanks team. will coordinate postmortem and include token-accounting checks in the runbook. leaving notes for next rotation.
